info.title: Gateline airport retail media API
info.description: REST API over the canonical model. Airport data enters only through adapters (AODB 33-column CSV, IATA AIDX FlightLegNotifRQ XML, ACI ACRIS NGSI-LD). Live updates: GET /api/stream (SSE).
